subtitle: Don't hand Power BI the raw fact table

eyebrow: A view built for Power BI, not analysts
code:
CREATE OR REPLACE SECURE VIEW rpt.sales_daily_summary AS
SELECT
    order_date,
    region,
    SUM(sales_amount)        AS total_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM analytics.fact_sales
GROUP BY order_date, region;
caption: Pre-aggregated to the grain a dashboard actually filters on.

code:
-- Works: single table, no join
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_daily_order_totals AS
SELECT order_date, SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales
FROM analytics.fact_sales
GROUP BY order_date;

-- Fact + dimension join? Use a scheduled
-- Task to populate a physical summary table instead.
caption: No joins allowed — that's most real reporting views.
